signs.Aries: You may find that you make quite an impact at the office today. You are feeling extremely well disposed toward the human race and have a smile for everyone. If you are having a platonic relationship with someone you would like to know more intimately, then use this increase in confidence to make your intentions more obvious.
signs.Taurus: This could be a marvelous day for socializing on all fronts. People are generally well disposed toward each other. If you are seeking romance, don't be surprised if it also comes looking for you, as you radiate a sense of warmth and optimism. With this very attractive vibration around you, you are very likely to meet someone who is equally as sunny as you.
signs.Gemini: It may be the feeling of being open to help someone that actually brings you into contact with that special person today. The energy of the day encourages the feeling of wanting to nurture those who seem to need help in some capacity or another. You exude warmth and a sense of hopefulness, and this is what attracts a certain person to want to know more about you.
signs.Cancer: The energy of the day brings a sense of adventure to your love life. You feel inspired to go further and do more creative and inventive things together with your partner. There is also a renewed sense of warmth between you that helps to rekindle the fires of love and brings you to a deeper appreciation of each other's good points. Life is smiling on you sweetly.
signs.Leo: Even you cannot stay permanently cross and critical of your loved one's faults, especially given the mood of today. You may even surprise them by complimenting them on something they have done particularly well, instead of noticing the minute error that created the problem. There is such a sunny feeling around that you may fall in love all over again, which could take you both by surprise.
signs.Virgo: The is going to be a day that is great for promoting each other's positive points while graciously accepting the behaviors that indicate that you are, after all, human. This could be a good time for all kinds of adventures, as you will both be at your most articulate and expressive. Wherever you go, people will respond to the warmth of your heart, and the smile on your face.
signs.Libra: If you are looking for that special relationship, then try not to adopt your usual appearance of dark and brooding intensity. The astral influence indicates that potential lovers will not respond to this call of the wild and are looking for an easier time. You need to lighten up and quit looking like someone who has just emerged from playing an extra in a horror movie.
signs.Scorpio: The celestial influence means that you can let it all hang out today - well most of it, at least. The bits you don't want to expose are only under cover until later. Your natural sense of warmth and humor comes out to play, and your presence lights up the room. It's no wonder that a line starts to form consisting of those ardently hoping you will date them.
signs.Sagittarius: Even though you may be dressed up in a smartly tailored suit and look like Mr. or Ms. Efficiency, the energy of the day ensures that you nevertheless can't help but let a warm smile replace your usual concerned frown. You feel like reaching out and showing others how much you really care and appreciate all they have done for you. Let your loved one know how much you appreciate them, as well.
signs.Capricorn: The astral alignment allows you to express a sense of caring and warmth without having to get too involved. If you are looking for romance, then you can be at your most attractive, witty, and unconventional, and others will be magnetically drawn to you. If you are already in a steady relationship, then you will feel that old warmth coming back, along with a renewed sense of sharing.
signs.Aquarius: If you are going anywhere tonight, you will be the center of attention, with a little help from the lovely energy of the celestial configuration. You truly glow, and people are drawn by your wonderful laugh. If you are looking for romance, you may well have to fight them off, as there could be so many to choose from. Lucky you!
signs.Pisces: Today you are likely to feel as though you love everyone. You feel so good about yourself and so contented with the world; altogether, you have a deliciously warm and friendly feeling inside. Not surprisingly, you could score a potentially high hit rate at parties. Everyone will respond to your charming smile. For once, you actually have a choice of dates.
